correctness.rationale: Monicity follows from P monic; for every lower-degree test polynomial the boundary integral on each polynomial level is the residue sum of f/P^k, which is zero since f/P^k=O(z^-2). Approximation handles critical levels. Polynomial change-of-variables counts exactly d preimages and gives norm pi(R^(2k)-r^(2k))/(dk). Uniqueness of the monic minimizer and capacity R^(1/d) give the stated exact ratio. CHECK.py provides only supplementary exact tests.

value.rationale: The theorem supplies complete exact degree-divisible Bergman optimizers and a universal exponential quantitative lake-removal law on an entire naturally defined family of polynomial shells, independent of domain geometry. It refines two established capacity/archipelago asymptotic questions with sharp coefficients, rather than recomputing an isolated sample. The limit of general domains and intermediate degrees is made explicit.
